items.title: Furniture: Modern 2
items.creator: Spark Universe
items.description:
Decorate your home with over 20,000 furniture options. Design your dream house, office, school, shop, and many more. Whatever you want. We've got it.

+ 700+ unique furniture models
+ 14x colors each
+ 22,000+ total options
+ Tons of decoration options
+ Big city with furniture store
items.changelog:
- Updated to Minecraft 26.2
- Added Vibrant Visuals support

items.title: Mozaria
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
You were summoned as a Great Warrior from the heavens to stop the speading of the darkness infection.
Defeat the monsters that lurks in your way and save the land of Mozaria!

- 9 new items
- Several deadly mobs
- Intense BOSS battle
- Over 1~ 3 hour gameplay
- Playable " solo" or " multiplayer"

Creator: Potomy

items.title: Summer Scuba Diving
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Dive into extreme underwater sports! Choose from 8 different skins with diving equipment and swimsuit or wetsuit. Role-play as a scuba diver and enjoy warm summer waters. It’s the perfect time to explore the ocean. Who knows what interesting things you’ll see?

1 free skin included!

items.title: Red Cloud Squad
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Put on a grand ninja robe and role-play as a real shinobi. Choose from 12 different skins with the special red cloud to honor the clan’s ancestors. Gear up and look mysterious in black cloaks with red lining and tall collar. Try to stay hidden in the shadows, so you can complete your mission and protect your people.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Little Mermaids
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Cute mermaid skins are perfect for the warm weather and role playing in your underwater castle. Your water world is not complete without a proper set of mermaid skins to dress up as!

- 10 skins

items.title: Infinity Snake Parkour
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Are you ready for this brand new parkour concept? This map has never been made before by anyone else! Try to stay on the snake while it's constantly moving, after a certain time it will only go faster and blocks will come to troll you! With Cubed Coins you can make the snake slower and longer!

+New parkour!
+Infinity parkour!
+Customizable settings!
+Hardcore & easy mode!

items.title: Cyber Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
The ultimate computer hacker? A robot, of course. Role-play as the best cyber spy around and break into any system. Choose from 8 different sneaky skins to steal all the secrets you can. Hack right past passwords and encryption to access all types of cool information.

1 free skin included!

items.title: MC Animals
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
There are so many lovable Minecraft animals! Which ones do you love the most? I know I could not survive without my trusty horse!

- 12 animal skins

items.title: Pirate Blocks
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Conquer the seas with these pirate block skins!

items.title: Age Of Robots
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
It's the year 3021 and the world consists of more robots than humans. Just like the humans of the past, these robots are very diverse in color, size and functionality. It is now time for the humans to become one with the leaders of the new world. Roleplay with your friends as one of the ten robot skins included in this skin pack.
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Dinosaurs HD
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Roar! Dinosaurs are the coolest! Roleplay and dress up in a giant reptile costume. Stomp around and rule the earth with fierce claws and sharp teeth.

- 13 skins

items.title: Element Masters Glitch Edition
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Element Masters have arrived now with a glitch edition, dominating different elements, their powers are impressive! Why are you waiting to acquire these amazing skins?

-11 skins
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Billionaire Summer Mansion
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Are you in need of a vacation? Want to relax on a beautiful tropical island? This dreamy mansion is the perfect summer resort. Time to live like a billionaire and enjoy a perfect getaway with your friends.

+ Vibrant Visuals compatible
+ Ride expensive vehicles
+ Sail on boats
+ Enjoy pool parties
+ Play sports
+ Great for role-playing with friends
+ 6 fresh HD skins
items.changelog:
+ Vibrant Visuals Compatible!
+ Various adjustments and improvements!
+ Build fixes

items.title: K-pop Icons
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These K-pop icons have just made a comeback and are now all the rage! They're setting new fashion trends all over the world!

- 8 skins!
- K-pop inspired skins sporting their famous clothing style!

items.title: Royal Mansions
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Live a royal lifestyle with your friends in your very own mansion or villa! Explore all of the gardens and rooms or race your friends from mansion to mansion in your brand new luxury cars!

+ 9 luxury vehicles
+ 4 mansions
+ Over 50 rooms
+ Royal gardens
+ By ArgoStudios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Space Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Fly up to the cosmos and build your space station. Visit new worlds and start your adventure with your friends. Enjoy the weightlessness!

+ Free skin
+ 10 skins
+ Space
+ Teens

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Streetwear Fashion
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
With Streetwear Fashion you will have the best style in every city, at every party! Great for fun roleplay with you and your buddies.

+ 12 skins
+ Great for roleplay
+ Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Dark and stealthy, their identity is shrouded in mystery. Look out it's the Masked Teens! With several different skins to choose from, you'll be ready for anything! As the night falls upon you, will you put your mask on and disappear into the night?

- 12 mysterious skins!
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Millionaire Mountain Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Mountain Mansion is everything you need! From fun rooms to natural environments, this mansion has tons of places to explore! Live inside of this mansion and enjoy all the luxury it has to offer! Become the coolest millionaire in the world!

- Mega mansion
- Modern design
- Great with friends!

items.title: Kingdom Come
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done! Become who you are meant to be in the kingdom! You are destined for greatness!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Medieval attire inspired by anime and history!

items.title: Everything Blue
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Do you like the color blue? With this set of blue outfits you can show off your favorite color!

+ 10 incredible cute looks
+ Perfect for role playing

From IcyJose

items.title: Lost Civilization
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Have you got what it takes to survive in a lost civilization? After civilization collapsed, nature reclaimed the city. But, some of us survived. Join us on our journey to find the missing blueprints, which we need to make pickups and quads! 

- Custom vehicles
- Exciting locations to explore
- Custom animals
- Backpacks

By Timolia

items.title: Retro City Fashion
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
It's throwback season! These retro clothes take you back to the 80s and 90s with all the fashionable trends at your fingertips. Dress up in your most stylish outfit and head out to the city with your friends in style!

+ 11 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Fashion 2021
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready to play as a modern-day fashionable teen? Tailored using the best trends these skins would be a perfect fit for popular teens.

+ Trendy fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
